articles.summary: New therapeutic developments and technologies are constantly on the horizon of the animal health industry. Many organizations working on regenerative medicines, reproductive technologies, biologics, vaccines, and advanced therapies face challenges when they begin to expand and commercialize. These programs heavily rely on supply chain partners to move their biologics through clinical stages and distribution, and that’s where many run into challenges. Transporting sensitive materials can lead to contamination, delays, or operational costs, if not properly handled.
articles.title: Risk Mitigation as Strategy: Why Prevention Pays in Animal Health Logistics

Our organization was recognized for being the first supply chain solutions company to receive ISO 21973 certification for advanced therapy logistics, making a meaningful impact on patient access to life-changing treatments worldwide.
articles.title: Cryoport Systems Wins 2026 BioServices Innovation of the Year Award for Industry Milestone in Advanced Therapy Logistics

articles.summary: Advanced therapy organizations face a number of operational complexities as they expand. While these organizations devote considerable resources to address pain points in the supply chain, many of these absorbed costs were actually avoidable in the first place. Developing an integrated cryopreservation strategy can help organizations reduce scrap rates, deviations, repeat testing, shipping failures, and schedule churn, ultimately improving the company’s bottom line.
articles.title: Cost Avoidance and Risk Reduction Through Integrated Cryopreservation
